text: Binary check on OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; only this column used): 1 if at least one comment explicitly cites a specific, concrete real-world example as part of its counter-argument, e.g. a named or particular actual case, event, person, institution, study, statistic tied to a case, or concrete personal experience; otherwise 0. Abstract principles, generic claims, and invented or hypothetical scenarios do not count; quoting the OP alone does not count. Ignore text that is an OP view-change or delta-award announcement, a post-outcome thank-you or resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic delta or platform-rule discussion stays eligible but counts only if it cites a specific instance. Any comment qualifying suffices; list order is irrelevant. A valid empty list returns 0; missing or malformed OC_comments returns null.
